verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs say its llms.txt index (confirmed live with HTTP 200) exposes "endpoints in OpenAPI" for AI agents, so machine-readable specs appear reachable through that index. However, probes of the standard spec locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) all returned 404, so no single canonical downloadable spec file is evidenced. These probes only tested guessed paths and do not contradict the vendor claim. missing for 10: a documented, directly downloadable full OpenAPI file at a stable URL, and hands-on confirmation that the OpenAPI content linked from llms.txt is complete and valid.
